blurb: Guests can drive go-karts on two circuits: Sherbrooke Mitsubishi (600m) for simple and double karts, and Hyundai Magog (1.4 km) for more powerful karts. Karts range from simple models for children as young as 2 (with adult) to 13hp karts for adults seeking extreme speeds. Group packages with qualifying and racing are available for groups of 10 or more, and two reception rooms can be rented for events.
